title: Coverage Ledger
description: Legacy implementation coverage of the discovery effort. Domain-neutral: no source or target technology is named in this schema.

$schema.description: Scheme-less relative path from the instance file to its schema file.

schema_version.description: Instance schema version. Major component pinned to the v1 directory; minor and patch are free.

subject.description: Generic label for the covered corpus.

unit_kind.description: Generic classification of the covered unit.

status.description: Discovery progress state of the unit.

feature_ids.description: Feature Contract id values associated with this unit.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence Reference id values grounding this entry.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about this entry.

total_units.description: Total number of units in the corpus.

covered_units.description: Number of units that have been covered.

identifier.description: Shared identifier grammar. Lowercase alphanumeric start; dots, underscores, and hyphens permitted.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp enforced by regex because the validator runs without a FormatChecker.

metadata.title: Free-form consumer metadata
metadata.description: Sanctioned extension point. Additional properties are permitted here only.
